title: Minimal empty command contract declaration (positive fixture)
description: Positive fixture: a conforming command contract declaration that declares nothing in any capability category — no lifecycle phases, no verification checks, no config extensions, no templates. A standard may declare nothing in a category, or nothing at all; the runtime proceeds with its generic operations for the lifecycle positions the standard does not cover (command-contract.md §4.1). The activation sequence is exactly prepare, configure, verify, promote — zero framework phases — with verify fixed immediately before promote. The verification exchange remains at the fixed 'verify' position with zero declared checks: a no-op gate, not an open door (verification-contract.md §4.4). The full exchange rule set C1–C7 plus the declared-surface bound (emptyDeclarationProceedsWithGenericOperations) is affirmed as the contract floor.
